scope: bounded source-to-query evaluation; not production-scale qualification

verifiedBehaviors: Cumulative unique-SOP consolidation across reception batches
Exact batch replay preserves the original generation

Publication failure stays hidden and is retryable
Full metadata retained inline or outside inventory in artifact bundles
Profile changes create new immutable generations; stale profile queries fail

Regular MongoDB query execution, generated Search mappings and query plans
Public gallery reaches reference architecture and rule/query playground
Public route rejects imported sources, arbitrary runtimes and ingestion actions

Automatic current-head promotion and retention/garbage collection
Actual Atlas Search execution or readiness polling
